TS0060001.message: Connector '{connector}' could not complete its connection test: {detail}
TS0060001.solution: Review the cause and check the connector configuration before trying again.

TS0060002.message: Target '{table}' cannot preserve source identity '{field}' as '{preserved}': {reason}.
TS0060002.solution: Check the configured source identity field, the target generated identity and the complete logical matching key. Existing fields and business constraints are never overwritten.

TS0060003.message: Connector '{connector}' could not check identity constraints for target '{table}': {detail}.
TS0060003.solution: Check target access and metadata permissions, then retry. An unavailable identity check does not authorize a write.

TS0060004.solution: Register the connector's artifact — or place it in the connector seed directory — before using it.

TS0060005.message: Connector '{connector}' resolves to more than one registered artifact: {artifacts}.
TS0060005.solution: Keep a single registered artifact per connector id; selecting among connector versions is not supported.

TS0060006.message: Connector '{connector}' is already registered under artifact {existing}; a different artifact {incoming} was refused.
TS0060006.solution: Keep a single registered artifact per connector id; unregister the existing artifact before registering a different one.

TS0060007.message: Manual connector uploads are unavailable in Cloud clusters.
TS0060007.solution: Use a connector bundled with the Cloud runtime image.

TS0060008.message: Runtime registration supports these connectors today: {official}. '{connector}' is not among them yet.
TS0060008.solution: Register one of the connectors listed above. The supported set grows as connectors complete certification, so an artifact refused here is not necessarily faulty.

TS0060009.solution: Check the connector jar and its dependencies are present and readable.

TS0060010.message: Connector '{connector}' has invalid server TLS trust material or conflicting TLS settings.
TS0060010.solution: Provide a valid CA certificate bundle with server verification enabled and no client private key.

TS0060011.message: Connector '{connector}' could not remove its temporary TLS material.
TS0060011.solution: Inspect the owning process file permissions before retrying cleanup.

TS0060012.message: Connector '{connector}' entry class '{class}' was not found or is not a connector.
TS0060012.solution: Check the connector id resolves to a connector jar that declares this entry class.

TS0060013.message: Connector artifact '{artifact}' could not be read.
TS0060013.solution: Check the artifact is a complete, readable connector jar (ZIP archive); download it again if it is truncated or corrupt.

TS0060014.message: No connector class found in artifact '{artifact}'.
TS0060014.solution: Check the jar is a PDK connector: it must contain a class annotated with @TapConnectorClass.

TS0060015.message: Artifact '{artifact}' declares more than one connector class: {classes}.
TS0060015.solution: Register one connector per artifact; split unrelated connectors into separate jars.

TS0060016.message: Connector artifact '{artifact}' names spec '{spec}' but the jar does not contain it.
TS0060016.solution: Check the connector build packages the spec resource named by its @TapConnectorClass annotation.

TS0060017.message: Connector artifact '{artifact}' spec '{spec}' does not identify the connector: {detail}.
TS0060017.solution: Ensure the spec resource is valid JSON and declares the connector id under properties.id.

TS0060018.message: Connection setting '{field}' of connector '{connector}' must be a {expected}, but its value is '{value}'.
TS0060018.solution: Give '{field}' a {expected} the connector can read, or remove it if the connection does not need it.

TS0060019.message: Oracle LogMiner connector '{connector}' cannot capture {kind} identifier '{identifier}' because it is longer than {limit} characters.
TS0060019.solution: Use an Oracle schema, table and column name no longer than {limit} characters, or select another supported Oracle capture mode.

TS0060020.message: Oracle LogMiner connector '{connector}' did not finish initialization and schema discovery within {timeout} and was stopped.
TS0060020.solution: Check that the Oracle source is reachable and responsive, or increase the LogMiner preflight timeout if discovery is expected to take longer.

TS0060021.message: Connector '{connector}' requires PDK API level {required} but this engine provides level {provided}.
TS0060021.solution: Use a connector build compatible with API level {provided}, or upgrade the engine.

TS0060022.message: Connector '{connector}' declares PDK API version {version}, which this engine build does not recognize.
TS0060022.solution: Use a connector built against a PDK API version this engine registers, or add {version} to the Tapstate-side level table if it is API-compatible.

TS0060023.message: Connector '{connector}' produced an event that could not be projected: {detail}.
TS0060023.solution: This is a bridge-level projection failure between the connector and the event envelope.

TS0060024.solution: Check the source is reachable and the connection settings are correct.

TS0060025.message: Testing '{connector}' exceeded {timeout}; inspect its current result before an explicit retry.
TS0060025.solution: Check the target and retry explicitly when the original test resources have ended.

TS0060026.message: Connector '{connector}' could not discover its schema.
TS0060026.solution: Check that the source database is reachable and the connection settings are correct, then refresh the schema.

TS0060027.solution: Check the target is reachable and the connection settings are correct.

TS0060028.message: Connector '{connector}' failed while reading the store: {detail}.
TS0060028.solution: Check the store is reachable and the connection settings are correct.

TS0060029.message: Snapshot preparation for connector `{connector}` could not complete: {reason}.
TS0060029.solution: Keep the saved recovery state and use a capture runtime that can durably accept the session metadata and stream position before reading rows.

TS0060030.message: Reading '{connector}' stopped before it finished, so the rows it returned are incomplete.
TS0060030.solution: The read was interrupted rather than refused; run it again.

TS0060031.message: Connector '{connector}' does not provide '{capability}', which this read needs.
TS0060031.solution: Read a source whose connector provides this capability, or use a verb that does not need it.

TS0060032.message: Every connection to '{connector}' was still busy after {timeout}.
TS0060032.solution: Another read of this connection is still running; retry, or narrow the read so it finishes sooner.

TS0060033.message: This host already holds its limit of {limit} live connector connections and all of them are busy.
TS0060033.solution: Wait for a running read to finish, or reduce how many connections are being read at once.

TS0060034.message: Reading '{connector}' took longer than {timeout} and was stopped.
TS0060034.solution: Narrow the read with a filter or a smaller limit, or check the store is not overloaded.

TS0060035.message: This connector tried to keep a value of type {type}, which cannot be stored.
TS0060035.solution: Report this against the connector: it is the connector's own state that cannot be held, not anything in your pipeline.

TS0060036.message: A note this connector kept for itself cannot be read back: {detail}.
TS0060036.solution: If this followed a downgrade, run the build that wrote it. Otherwise clear the pipeline's state to start the connector fresh, which makes it read its source from the beginning.

TS0060037.message: Connector '{connector}' produced a stream position that could not be recorded: {detail}.
TS0060037.solution: Without a recordable position this source can only be read from the present; report the connector build that produced it.

TS0060038.message: Connector '{connector}' could not read back the recorded stream position: {detail}.
TS0060038.solution: Read the source from the beginning again, or set an explicit start point, so a fresh position is recorded.

TS0060039.message: Connector '{connector}' could not be told how far it may release its change log: {detail}.
TS0060039.solution: The change stream keeps running and this is retried shortly; until it succeeds the source keeps change log it could already release. Check the source is reachable and the connection settings are correct.

TS0060040.message: Connector '{connector}' could not let go of what it set up on its source to read changes ({resources}): {detail}.
TS0060040.solution: The pipeline's state was cleared anyway. Remove what is named here on the source by hand; for a PostgreSQL replication slot, run pg_drop_replication_slot with its name once no session is using it. Until then the source keeps change log for it.

TS0060041.message: Schema discovery for {connector} timed out while waiting for the database.
TS0060041.solution: Check that the database is running and that the connector can reach its host and port, then refresh the schema.

TS0060042.message: Schema discovery for {connector} was rejected by the database's authentication checks.
TS0060042.solution: Check the data source username, password and authentication settings, then refresh its schema. If the credentials are correct, ask the database administrator to check the account.
